subject: Post-call recap: Medlytics expansion pilot scope & timeline
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 18:32:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap: Medlytics expansion pilot scope & timeline

Hi Sarah and Tom —

Thanks again for the demo and candid conversation today. Quick recap while it’s fresh and to confirm the pilot scope we discussed. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Spikes in latency for live chat during batch billing cycles (~95th percentile > 500ms).
- Unpredictable token spend on embeddings for nightly RAG jobs.
- Need for stronger data isolation and audit logs for PHI-related flows.

Primary goals for next 3 months:
1) Reduce interactive latency to <=200ms p95 for the chat route.
2) Move embeddings pipeline to a more predictable pricing profile and targeted quantization for cost savings.
3) Validate private deployment controls (KMS + audit logs) for regulated workloads.

Agreed pilot outline (what we’ll deliver):
- 6-week Dedicated pilot (reserved GPU pool) supporting chat and batch embeddings.
- Scope: 2 chat routes (low-latency + fallback), nightly embedding job (up to 20M tokens/month).
- Success metrics: p95 latency on chat under 200ms, embedding cost per million tokens reduced by 25% vs current baseline, verification of audit-log delivery to your SIEM.

Timeline we agreed:
- Kickoff & onboarding: week of May 18 (technical kickoff, data flow diagram, access for infra).
- Mid-pilot usage review: June 15 (benchmarks and cost analysis).
- Decision on scaling or contract amendment: target July 1.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Mina: Share SOW draft and usage snapshot (attached) by EOD tomorrow.
- Nikhil: Prep config checklist for Dedicated pilot and list of network requirements.
- Marissa: Build canary rollout plan for chat route with rollback criteria.
- Sarah / Tom: Confirm internal stakeholders for security review and provide sample log shipping endpoint.

Attachments: usage_report_Medlytics_Q1.csv (baseline token/latency snapshot), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (initial scope).

If that aligns, I’ll kick off the SOW update and schedule the May 18 technical kickoff invite.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@medlytics.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Medlytics expansion pilot scope & timeline

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. This matches our internal notes. Two quick clarifications before we proceed: 

1) For the embeddings workload, the 20M tokens/month figure is an upper bound — during the pilot we expect 8–12M tokens in normal operation and up to 20M for stress tests. Is the Dedicated pool configurable to burst for the stress window?

2) On audit logs: we can provide a customer-managed S3 endpoint and a CloudWatch stream. Our security team wants to see an example retention and redaction policy.

We’ll confirm the security contacts (adding Tom and our compliance lead, Priya, offline) and can commit to the May 18 kickoff. Please send SOW and the usage CSV so our procurement can start the review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sarah

Sarah Lim
Head of Platform Engineering | Medlytics
sarah.lim@medlytics.com | +1 (617) 555-2066

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Medlytics expansion pilot scope & timeline

Sarah — great, thanks for the quick confirmation and the extra detail. A few follow-ups inline and next items from our side: 

- Bursting: Yes — Dedicated can be configured with burst capacity rules. Nikhil, I’ll loop you separately to confirm the exact burst policy and cost envelope for stress windows.

- Logs/retention: Monica, can you prepare a short example retention/redaction matrix (30/90/365 day options) and an example delivery verification plan we can share with Medlytics security?

Next items I’m sending now: SOW draft + usage_report_Medlytics_Q1.csv (attached). I also created the HubSpot deal and added the kickoff milestone: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-4821.

Planned invites:
- Technical kickoff: May 18, 10am PT (Zoom link to follow) — Mina, Marissa, Nikhil, Sarah, Tom, Priya
- Security sync (Medlytics security + Redwood security): week of May 20 (date TBD)

Procurement note: Marissa, I’ll run SOW v2 through legal for redlines; would like to get procurement feedback by May 25 so we can keep the July 1 decision target.

If that schedule looks good I’ll lock the kickoff invite this afternoon.

Thanks —
Mina
